content: Offline-first single-user sync pattern: local IndexedDB (Dexie) is the source of truth; network is an optional sync channel. Per-record metadata acts as breadcrumbs: syncStatus (pending/synced/failed), isModified/isNew/isDeleted, version or updatedAt timestamp. Last-write-wins is the right strategy for a single curator (no real conflict resolution needed). A sync queue records dirty entities; when online, push dirty records to cloud and mark synced. Service Worker + Background Sync API can replay queued writes without the tab open. For an own-cloud snapshot model, sync = serialize dirty shard(s) to provider files.
